title: English Practice Quiz 0136
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.
